title: PTPv2: Add support for authentication TLV
description: Add support for PTPv2 authentication TLV.  Current versions of Wireshark can recognize the TLV, but are not aware of how to parse it.  This PR adds support for parsing the authentication TLV.[ptp-auth-tlv.pcap](/uploads/ce8ba31cf434b7badc0f2d02d437d651/ptp-auth-tlv.pcap)
